name: Stabilized Ochre Jelly

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-06: Signal from the Electric Laboratory

items.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
items.text: A ochre jelly can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

items.name: Splorch
items.text:
Trigger An adjacent creature hits the ochre jelly with a Strike that would deal slashing or piercing damage

Effect A gout of acidic jelly shoots out at the attacker. The attacker must attempt a DC 22 Reflex save save.

---

Critical Success The attacker is unaffected.

Success The attacker takes 1d6 acid damage.

Failure The attacker takes 2d6 acid damage.

Critical Failure The attacker takes 2d6 acid damage and 2 persistent,acid damage.

items.name: Constrict
items.text:
1d8+3 bludgeoning damage plus 1d4 acid damage, DC 23 basic Fortitude save save

---

items.name: Ochre Acid
items.text: An ochre jelly's acid damages only flesh-not bone, stone, wood, or other materials.

text: Slimes, molds, and other oozes can be found in dank dungeons and shadowed forests. While not necessarily evil, some grow to enormous sizes and have insatiable appetites.
